Persona keeps it, not us, and we ask Persona to delete it 30 days after your result. We ask for your consent first.

You can get a free copy of your report from Checkr, and you can dispute anything in it with them.

capture.explanation: First, take photos of your ID and a selfie. Our team compares them, usually within a day. Then our ID partner double-checks your ID. It takes about 5 minutes in all.

stages.label: The two parts of your ID check

notice.title: Before you take your photos
notice.body: To check that you are the person on your ID, we take photos of your ID and a selfie that follows an instruction, and our trust and safety team compares your face with the photo on the ID. Then our ID partner, Persona, double-checks your ID and a selfie using face geometry, a biometric identifier. The photos are used only to verify your identity. We keep ours encrypted until both checks are finished and delete them no later than 30 days after our decision; we ask Persona to delete theirs 30 days after its result. We ask for your consent first.

notice.required: Agree to the ID and selfie check to take your photos.

capture.privacy: Only our trust and safety team sees your photos, and every view is logged. An automated reader (Claude, by Anthropic) reads the name, dates and ID number on the front of your ID for them; we keep only its yes-or-no answers, never your name, birth date or ID number, plus a one-way code made from the number, issuing state and birth date that can't be turned back into them, only to spot the same ID on two accounts. Your photos are stored encrypted and deleted no later than 30 days after our decision.
